name: worklog
description: What you worked on, day by day, from your Claude Code sessions and git: /standup for the last work day or the week, /worklog for any day or a week's timesheet, by repo, PR and branch with the time spent

idleGapMin.title: Idle gap (minutes)
idleGapMin.description: A gap this long with nothing happening ends a stretch of work

leadInMin.title: Lead-in (minutes)
leadInMin.description: Time added before the first message of a stretch, for reading and thinking before you typed

maxUnattendedMin.title: Claude working alone (minutes)
maxUnattendedMin.description: How long after your last message Claude's work still counts as your time

dayStartsAt.title: Day starts at
dayStartsAt.description: When one day ends and the next begins, as HH:MM. Work before this counts toward the day before

workDays.title: Work days
workDays.description: Comma-separated days you work, such as mon,tue,wed,thu,fri. /standup reports since the last one

excludeProjects.title: Folders to leave out
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated folder paths worklog never reads, such as private client work

includeNonRepo.title: Count work outside repos
includeNonRepo.description: Show sessions in folders that aren't git repos as Other

includePrompts.title: Quote your prompts
includePrompts.description: Summaries quote up to three of the prompts you typed for each branch. Turn off if you paste standups where your prompts shouldn't go

weekStartsOn.title: Week starts on
weekStartsOn.description: The first day of a week in the timesheet and /standup week

roundTo.title: Round the timesheet to (minutes)
roundTo.description: Each cell rounds to this, and each day's cells still add up to its rounded total: 0, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30 or 60. 0 rounds nothing

useGitHub.title: Read GitHub
useGitHub.description: Use your gh login to read PR titles and states, the PRs you reviewed and your open PRs. Read only; skipped when gh isn't signed in

extraRoots.title: More folders with repos
extraRoots.description: Comma-separated folders whose repos (two levels down) are read too, for work done without Claude: ~/code

csvFolder.title: Save CSVs to
csvFolder.description: Where the Week view's Save CSV writes
